_note: Example department for the `agent` node type (Life#157). Standalone graph, NOT composed into any instance: these sample skills are illustrative and must not receive real messages. Paths are relative to this directory. Verify with: python -m suite_core.nodes agent reparto demoAgenti --graph tooling/suite-tooling/examples/reparto-agenti/life.graph.json

reparto.persona: Route text requests for the sample department: summaries to one agent and translations to the other.

nodi.riassuntore: summarizes text in a few bullet points without adding anything
nodi.traduttore: translates text between Italian and English while preserving tone
